import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top products by total revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(product_revenue.index)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by customer age group and payment method
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_payment.index])
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[0, 1], 
                 color=['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Payment Method', loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(axes[0, 1].get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 3. Takeaway vs Dine-in comparison
takeaway_data = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({'total': 'sum', 'quantity': 'sum'})
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_takeaway = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
explode = (0.05, 0.05)
axes[1, 0].pie(takeaway_data['total'], labels=takeaway_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=colors_takeaway, explode=explode, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 11})
axes[1, 0].set_title('Revenue Split: Dine-in vs Takeaway', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Average transaction value by size and product category
top_products = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().nlargest(5).index
df_top = df[df['product'].isin(top_products)]
size_avg = df_top.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_avg = size_avg[[s for s in size_order if s in size_avg.columns]]
x = np.arange(len(size_avg.index))
width = 0.25
for i, size in enumerate(size_avg.columns):
    axes[1, 1].bar(x + i * width, size_avg[size], width, label=size, alpha=0.8)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Avg Transaction Value by Size (Top 5 Products)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x + width)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(size_avg.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Size', framealpha=0.9)
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
